taiwan-ncpc-2007.notes: Same index page serves as source 2 for many editions; our copy is the page as it stands for the 2026 contest year.

sources.evidence: Index of problem files by ROC year, 91 to 114, with the entry for ROC year 96 (2007).

taiwan-ncpc-2012.notes: Same index page serves as source 2 for many editions; our copy is the page as it stands for the 2026 contest year.

sources.evidence: Index of problem files by ROC year, 91 to 114, with the entry for ROC year 101 (2012).

taiwan-ncpc-2014.notes: The site is the MOE national software contest site, not a site of the 2014 NCPU contest held in Taichung in June; catalogue should drop it as a source. The news items from 2014 concern the MOE contest's own autumn 2014 round.

sources.evidence: The crawl is the multi-year site of the Ministry of Education national collegiate software design contest run by National Taiwan Normal University, and nothing in it names the June 2014 contest.

taiwan-ncpc-2015.notes: Index page for the MOE national contest, with a 104年 entry (initial round and final round, application software group files); not shown to be about the 2015 NCPU contest for private universities.

sources.evidence: The page is the multi-year index of problem files of the Ministry of Education national collegiate software contest (entry for ROC year 104, 2015), and it never names the NCPU contest for private universities of July 2015.
